streams.name: prompts and long text
steps: ADS1299 learning lab. BENCH ONLY; remove ALL body electrodes.
BREADBOARD: ADS control lines parked low. Switch on the AFE 5 V, measure AVDD at the chip legs (4.75-5.25 V) and 3V3; then type R.
BREADBOARD: chip awake. Measure VCAP1 (leg 28 to ground) above 1.1 V; then type V. This firmware does not sense voltages.
BREADBOARD: type T for the internal test signal or N for shorted inputs (noise). There is no electrode mode.
